reviews.x: Notes out of the box; * Very nice, low profile footprint design. * 7 inches long, 5 inches at widest part of the oval, 2.5 inches tall. * Fits up to .75 oz polishes with all shaped bottle necks (bam! take that iZen Pro!) * Silver plastic, no idea on solvent resistance (yet). * Uses both AC adapter or batteries for cordless operation. * 5600 shakes per minute promises the box and spec detail. * 3 detachable, adjustable rubber securing straps. * 1 on/off button, with a lighter pressure 'pulse on'

I have over 200 bottles of regular nail polish, more than 30 gel polishes and about 40 stamping polishes.  I really wanted to try a lacquer shaker to help my polishes to apply more smoothly and last longer, but they were all so expensive until this one came out.  I finally felt like I could afford to try out a polish shaker without breaking the bank.  Here are some of the finer points about this shaker:  It has been able to shake EVERY shape and type of bottle that I've used it for.  This includ

so far so good. I injured my wrist really bad and it has made simple tasks difficult. So when I want to do my nails and my polish needs a little shake-up I pop it into this Shaker and let in ride for 30 second intervals depending on how settled the polish is :-)  It also makes mixing your own tints and colors easy (adding eye shadow to clear polish).

Very displeased with this. The directions say to shake the polish for around 20 seconds, but that had nearly no effect on a settled glitter polish. After running it for about 2 minutes it did OK. An hour later I tried a 2nd bottle and the machine smelled like burning plastic, then quit working altogether. Returned; I didn't like it well enough to get it exchanged.

reviews.t: I own several hundred bottles of nail polish and was ...
reviews.x: I own several hundred bottles of nail polish and was excited to shake some new life into a few of the older ones. Over the course of a couple days the shaker worked fairly well for the first 50 or so polishes and then the motor slowly died. It got slower and slower and then just stopped shaking all together. Not worth the money for the time it lasted.
Works as advertised. Saves my wrist a lot of pain!!

Seriously underwhelming.  I was hoping that this would be able to help me mix some of my gel polished and regular polishes that tend to settle better than me trying to mix them by hand.  Although the machine makes a lot of noise and may make you think it's working, it did a terrible job.  Even after leaving polishes on the machine for several minutes, switching the direction of the polish, etc., it was far more effective for me to just shake them.  Me shaking them by hand was not only faster but

reviews.t: Save your money, it's not that great.
reviews.x: This sucks! I tested with a polish that had been sitting for a while. After all, I'm capable of giving a few arm shakes of a polish that's already fairly well mixed. I bought this specifically for polish that needs some extra help. Does not do the job. It's more quiet than some and has little rubber feet so it doesn't slide everywhere (but still moves a little). Wouldn't recommend, wouldn't purchase again. After trying several bottles, I donated it so someone else could try it.

reviews.t: Arrived broken, would not turn on.
reviews.x: I was so excited to get this, but when I got it, it was broken. I could not get it to work by plugging it in or installing batteries. I was a little disappointed I couldn't exchange it for a new one, and now there are none in stock. I've heard great things about this shaker and for now I'm still stuck shaking my polishes by hand. I'll update this review when/if I get a working shaker.

reviews.t: I would recommend the opi shaker
reviews.x: Bought it for the nail salon. It doesnt work that well. I would recommend the opi shaker better
Gave this as a gift to my nail technician. They bought three more for the shop.  woot woot.
Sparks fly from outlet when plugging in this item. Returning for refund.

reviews.t: but this weak pile of crap can't even mix an INK once it's been sitting ...
reviews.x: This "shaker" can barely even mildly agitate my miniature paints. They're the same size as a nail polish bottle and the same consistency, but this weak pile of crap can't even mix an INK once it's been sitting a few days. I'm likely to return it for a refund, since it basically doesn't do anything.

First one received would not work with cord only battery. So I returned it, returned was processed quickly. Received second worked just not a great mixer unfortunately. Just not powerful enough. Ended up getting tattoo ink mixer. Works much better
As a licensed Nail Tech, I am so disappointed! Didn't even turn on once! tried both the ac adapter as well as putting in new batteries. Absolutely not Happy!
I don't know if it was just defective, but this thing did not work at all!!!

I am a nail tech and in school was taught to not shake the bottles but to roll the bottle before using but thought I would give this a try. It is kinda noisy but really don't see anyway around it so I am not going to hold it against them. The machine seems to shake itself more than it does the polish. I have found putting a towel under it keeps it from shaking off the table and helps with the noise a little. I have tried regular nail polish and gel polish in this machine and would say that it di

I like this; however, I don't think it shakes fast enough or enough. I have some nail polishes with quite a bit of glitter and the glitter didn't move!! The bottle was on its side for a while and the glitter had floated to one side. I used this shaker and had it there for what seemed like forever and maybe a few pieces of glitter moved.  Please let me know if someone recommends something better. I love nail polish and have too many bottles. I think it's good to shake them up once in a while and

Could not do my gel manicures without this shaker! It is very lightweight and works beautifully. It doesn't dance all over the table like some of the other shakers, and does an excellent job. I do switch the direction of the bottle that is shaking after a minute, and let it shake for another minute. It's very important to shake your gel before application and this does the job very, very well.

Worked OK st first, but then I could hear loose parts rattling around inside after a month. Took it apart, and was able to get everything back in the right place and working properly for quite a while.  Hadn't used it for a couple of months, and now it won't run unless I'm holding down one of the "on" buttons. This thing should cost about $10.

reviews.t: I do not know if I got a bad item but this did not work for me at ...
reviews.x: Really was in need of a nail polish shaker as I have well over 100 bottles of regular nail polish.. I do not know if I got a bad item but this did not work for me at all.. Barely shook up the nail polish,maybe if it had a higher speed setting or a different way to shake it it would be more beneficial but unfortunately it didn't work for me :(

Bought this in mid July of this year, when it arrived it worked for exactly one bottle of polish. Didn't need to use it again til now and now it will not work at all. The box says it has a 100% Unconditional Guarentee but Amazon (whom I bought it from) will not take it back for return, exchange or repair. Very disappointed.

I'm really glad I ordered this shaker!  It works great😄. I have a lot of regular and gel polishes that get used rarely, and if shaken for aminute behave as if new.. I have had absolutely no problems with it at all, it performs as advertised.  I would recommend it to anyone when wants the life of their polishes extended.

So far, this polish shaker has worked well, and its price point is WAY better than others currently on the market.  It does a good job of getting all the colors thoroughly mixed, which is challenging to do by just hand-shaking, since gel polishes are very dense. We shall see how long it holds up.

The lacked shaker broke after 3 times of using it ,it makes bad noise and don't do anything to shake that polish ,I can do better by hand ! It feels like it has loose part inside that rattles ! I  did try to return it but it pass 30 days ,so I feel cheated ! The worst product I bought on Amazon

claims.text: Several reviewers report the shaker is not powerful enough to mix settled polish or other thick liquids effectively.
Multiple units failed or arrived broken, including motors dying and devices that would not turn on.
Some reviewers praise it for saving their wrists and working as advertised.
A few reviewers highlight its affordability and usefulness for large polish collections.
There are isolated reports of safety hazards, including sparks from the outlet.
